contest: Fewest followers: whoever has the fewest followers when the round ends.

story.line: White is about fewer followers: you use stuff and then you get rid of it. Members from any color do their On Recruit or On Use, then get cast out to the discard pile, and saved white turns into followers at once.
story.greatGame: Round I: take Allowance or Exchange for white, and recruit cheap members whose On Recruit pays right away, plus Downsizers or Undertaker. Round II: Farewell or Estate Sale and Downsizers cast out the used members for followers or white; Recluse pays while your cult stays small. Round III: Heiresses tops up white, then Cash In or Cashier turns 12 or more white into followers in one turn. Rivals take Cash In first, steal your white, or buy Cashier before you.
freshStart: Space, round I, Sell Off: "Cast out one of your members costing 4 or less to the discard pile. +4 white."
Space, round II, Vow of Poverty: "Lose followers down to the fewest any rival has. +2 white per follower lost."
Space, round III, Cash In: "Turn all your white into followers. +1 white." (kept)
Member, Pilgrims: "On Recruit: +4 white. Round End: cast this member out to the discard pile."
Member, Mourners: "Whenever any player casts out a member, +1 white."

cards.name: Allowance
cards.text: +3 white in round I, +4 in round II, +5 in round III. This turn, if you recruit a member, +1 follower in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III.
cards.bestTurn: Round I, first turn: +3 white, then I recruit a 4-cost member with it and take +1 follower on top.
cards.topCase: Round III, recruiting every time I land here: +5 white and +3 followers, about 8 in value, against Cash In (often 8 to 12) or Initiation (a free member up to 8). Not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: A plain income space with a recruit bonus stuck on; the bonus is the same as Splurge's.
cards.ties: Pays for recruiting members, which pulls against White's own Fewest followers contest and its cast-out cards.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 6: "i dont like the white actions", "white needs a bigger white gain in the begining", "just buff those by +1 white" (all three round I spaces).
cards.why: The reliable white income every White plan starts from; it stays because nothing on the list beats it, not because players will miss its bonus.

cards.name: Splurge
cards.text: This turn, if you recruit a member, +1 follower for every 2 resources you pay for it (every 1 in round II). +2 white.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I recruit a 7-cost member and get +7 followers, plus +2 white.
cards.topCase: Round II with a 9-cost member: +9 followers and +2 white, about the size of a round III space a round early. Round I and III pay half (a 4-cost member gives +2). Not broken, but uneven by round.
cards.ideaWhy: Cost math, with a different rate in round II only; Cory had to take a list's word on the numbers.
cards.ties: Rewards buying big members, the opposite of White's fewer-followers, cast-out story; it ties to nothing else White does.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 1: "I'm okay with your splurge recommendation" (per 1 in round II only). Nov 6: "i dont like the white actions".
cards.why: Cost math with a round II exception, and a near twin of Allowance's recruit bonus on the same ring.

cards.name: Exchange
cards.text: +2 white. Then turn up to 1 resource (2 in round II, 3 in round III) into 2 followers each.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I turn 3 spare blue into 6 followers and keep my recruit for a member: 3 more than buying them.
cards.topCase: Round III, every time: +2 white and 6 followers for 3 resources, about +5 over buying followers. Not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: Trade resources in at double rate; easy to read once played.
cards.ties: Soaks up any color's leftover resources, so a table rich from Magenta steals or Yellow swaps feeds it.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 6: "i dont like the white actions" (got +1 white).
cards.why: A clear double-rate trade that grows each round; small in round I.

cards.name: Farewell
cards.text: Cast out one of your members to the discard pile, gain followers equal to its cost. +1 white.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, my 6-cost Martyrs already gave what they could: I cast them out, +6 followers here and +6 from Martyrs.
cards.topCase: Round II with Martyrs and Undertaker: +6 +6 +2, minus 3 for the members lost = +11, near twice the round II contest (+6). Without Martyrs a 6-cost member nets +5. Strong with Martyrs, not broken alone.
cards.ideaWhy: Use a member up, then trade it in: White's story in one line.
cards.ties: Empties your cult toward Recluse and the Fewest followers contest's opposite, and feeds the discard pile everyone can see.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 4: mandatory again, "some actions its good to maybe not want to copy... even more reason not to pick them last".
cards.why: The clearest card for Cory's "use stuff and then you get rid of it", but it shares its moment with Estate Sale.

cards.name: Estate Sale
cards.text: Cast out one of your members to the discard pile, gain white equal to its cost. +1 white.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, I cast out a used 6-cost member: +7 white, which I hold for Cash In next round.
cards.topCase: Round II, 6-cost member into 7 white, then Cash In in round III turns it into 7 followers: Farewell a round late, or a free member instead. Not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: Same action as Farewell on the same ring, paying white instead of followers.
cards.ties: Fills your white for Cash In and Cashier; white you hold is what Magenta steals.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 7 9:22pm: "the white estate sale, no… It should go to the discard. White is all about like fewer followers… you use stuff and then you get rid of it" (kept as live).
cards.why: Cory kept it on Nov 7; its only problem is sitting beside Farewell.

cards.name: Cash In
cards.text: Turn all your white into followers. +1 white.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I've held 12 white since round II: one minion, +12 followers, and my recruit still free.
cards.topCase: Round III with Heiresses and Estate Sale feeding it: 12 to 15 followers, against Initiation (a free member up to 8). Up to about twice the best other space; first minion here wins it, so rivals block it.
cards.ideaWhy: Save white, cash it all at once, no cap.
cards.ties: Every White card that makes white points here, and every rival watches it; Magenta steals of white hurt it most.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 22: "the idea is you can have a lot of white and go above 10." Nov 1: "keep Cash In as something to reconsider. white in general needs a little revisiting." Nov 4 on Heiresses: "It combos really nicely with the round III white action".
cards.why: White's round III payoff and a real race to block, but Cory has it on his reconsider list and Cashier does the same thing.

cards.name: Recluse
cards.text: Round End: +2 followers per rival with more members than you.
cards.bestTurn: I keep 2 members and cast out the rest; each round end all 3 rivals have more: +6 followers.
cards.topCase: Built around it every round: +6 a round, 18 a game, against a round III contest worth 10. Not broken.
cards.ties: Rewards casting out and punishes counts-as-3 members like Brokers and Martyrs; anything that shrinks your cult helps.
cards.why: Steady and on story; pays without a big moment.

cards.name: Downsizers
cards.text: On Use, once per round: cast out one of your members to the discard pile. +4 white.
cards.bestTurn: Each round I cast out a cheap member whose On Recruit already fired: +4 white, saved for Cash In.
cards.topCase: Three rounds with Undertaker: 12 white and +6 followers, minus the members lost. Not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: Sell off a used member every round.
cards.ties: Lets any color's one-shot members leave on your terms, and feeds Undertaker, Martyrs and Recluse.
cards.why: The engine piece of the cast-out plan; flat +4 every time, no peak.

cards.name: Barker
cards.text: Each time you recruit a member, you may also recruit followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I recruit a member and also buy 10 followers with 10 leftover resources in the same turn.
cards.topCase: Every turn with spare resources: one extra follower buy per member recruited (more with extra-recruit cards). Saves turns, not followers; not broken.
cards.ties: Stacks with any card that gives extra recruits (Cory: "if you recruit three times via spree, you can get an extra buy for followers each time").
cards.coryNotes: Nov 4: "White should definitely have a member that gives an extra buy each turn"; "you can always recruit followers, even if you recruited a member using your one buy/recruit".
cards.why: Cory asked for it; useful, but it's about buying more, not letting go.

cards.name: Heiresses
cards.text: On Use, once per game: +1 white per member you have.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 7 members: +7 white, then Cash In turns 15 white into 15 followers.
cards.topCase: Round III with 8 members: +8 white once, then Cash In. Big but once; not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: One big payday, timed by you.
cards.ties: Pulls against Recluse and casting out (more members pays more); once for the card, so rivals can steal it before it's used.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 4: "I like heiresses quite a bit"; "dont change heiresses, thats all. It combos really nicely with the round III white action".

cards.name: Brokers
cards.text: Whenever a White action gives you followers, +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: I take Exchange, then Farewell, then Cash In: +3 followers over the game on top.
cards.topCase: Every White space that pays followers: about +4 to +5 a game. Not broken; it's mostly a worth-3 body.
cards.ideaWhy: A +1 bonus stuck on other cards, with no moment of its own.
cards.ties: Counts as 3 members, which hurts Recluse and the cast-out plan it should support.
cards.why: A small add-on nobody remembers after the game; the one you'd miss least.

cards.name: Misers
cards.text: Game End: +1 follower per 2 white you hold.
cards.bestTurn: Game end with 10 white left: +5 followers.
cards.topCase: Holding 16 white at the end: +8, but buying followers or Cash In turns the same white into 16. Never better than spending it.
cards.ties: Competes with Cash In and Cashier for the same white at half their rate.
cards.why: Paying half rate for white you could cash in at full rate; no turn where it's the right play.

cards.name: Cashier
cards.text: On Recruit: turn all your white into followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, holding 9 white, I recruit Cashier: +9 followers and a member in one buy.
cards.topCase: Round III with 12 white: +12 followers for a 5-cost card, Cash In's size without the space. Strong, not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: Save white, cash it all at once.
cards.ties: A second Cash In rivals can't block on the wheel, only by buying it first.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 22: "a really good one… a good example".

cards.name: Undertaker
cards.text: Whenever you cast out one of your members, +2 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round II, Farewell then Downsizers: two cast-outs, +4 followers on top.
cards.topCase: Every cast-out chance (Farewell, Estate Sale, Downsizers each round): about 5 cast-outs, +10 a game. Not broken.
cards.ties: Makes every cast-out card better and gives members from any color a reason to leave.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 22, on "+2 followers whenever you send a member to the bottom": "close… a good idea", but the wording wasn't right.
cards.why: On story and steady; its moment rides on the other cast-out cards.

cards.name: Money Changers (White Cloak)
cards.bestTurn: Every follower buy refunds 2 white toward Cash In.
cards.topCase: Buying followers most turns: about +10 white a game. Not broken.
cards.ties: Pairs with Barker and Cash In; touches nothing outside White.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 7 12:55am: "ok" to the cloak set; Nov 6: "down to try it".

cards.name: Martyrs
cards.text: Whenever this member leaves your cult, gain followers equal to its cost.
cards.bestTurn: A rival steals my Martyrs and I still get +6; or I Farewell them for +12 in one turn.
cards.topCase: Round II, Farewell plus Undertaker: +6 +6 +2 minus 3 worth = +11, about twice the round II contest. Strong, near the top line, not broken.
cards.ties: Turns a rival's steal or swap into a gift for you, and doubles Farewell.
cards.why: A good cast-out payoff that also blunts theft; counts as 3, which fights Recluse.

cards.name: Old Money
cards.text: Game End: +1 follower per white member you have.
cards.bestTurn: Game end with 5 White members: +5 followers.
cards.topCase: Built around it: 5 or 6 White members, +6 at most, and it rewards keeping members White is meant to cast out.
cards.ties: Works against Farewell, Downsizers, Recluse and the fewer-followers story.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 22, no to "Game end +1 follower per white member": "not a great batch… didn't really line up with the theme."
cards.why: Cory turned down this exact card on Oct 22, and it rewards holding on.

cards.name: Magpie
cards.text: On Use, once per game: turn all your resources into white.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, I turn 8 mixed resources into white, then Cash In for 10 followers without spending my recruit.
cards.topCase: Round III before Cash In: saves one recruit (buying followers already turns any color 1:1). Small; not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: Translating currencies is Yellow's job, and it only matters next to Cash In.
cards.ties: Overlaps Yellow's "translate currencies"; a second once-per-game card in White beside Heiresses.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 4: renamed from Hoarder, rule unchanged. On once-per-game cards: "we shouldnt have too many of them".
cards.why: Does Yellow's job, and it only saves a recruit.

overlaps: Cash In "Turn all your white into followers. +1 white." and Cashier "On Recruit: turn all your white into followers.": the same payoff, on a space and a member.

Farewell "Cast out one of your members to the discard pile, gain followers equal to its cost. +1 white." and Estate Sale "Cast out one of your members to the discard pile, gain white equal to its cost. +1 white.": same action, same round II ring.

Allowance "...This turn, if you recruit a member, +1 follower in round I, +2 in round II, +3 in round III." and Splurge "This turn, if you recruit a member, +1 follower for every 2 resources you pay for it (every 1 in round II). +2 white.": both round I, both pay followers for recruiting a member.
Downsizers "On Use, once per round: cast out one of your members to the discard pile. +4 white." and Estate Sale: both cast out for white.
Magpie "On Use, once per game: turn all your resources into white." and Yellow's translating currencies: the colors overlap.
Misers "Game End: +1 follower per 2 white you hold." and Cash In: the same white into followers, at half the rate.
notes: White's contest is Fewest followers, yet five of its six spaces pay followers, so taking White's spaces usually loses White's contest. Cory's Nov 7 direction (members from any color used then cast out) is served by Farewell, Estate Sale, Downsizers, Undertaker, Martyrs and Recluse; Allowance, Splurge, Old Money and Heiresses reward having or recruiting members instead. The round III payoff sits on one space, Cash In, backed by Cashier, so blocking it is the main counter, plus stealing white.
